verdict.rationale: monday.com hosts AI agents and an AI app builder (monday vibe), so restoring an agent session to an earlier checkpoint is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows no session checkpointing or rollback. The developer MCP's ability to "promote versions" concerns app deployments, not restoring an agent's session state, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
